description.value: The Black Creek Community Centre serves as the cultural and recreational hub of the Black Creek area on Vancouver Island, grown through many expansions from its community roots. It offers a fitness room, facility rentals for events, program registration, and outdoor amenities to the surrounding region. Touring cyclists passing through the area will find a publicly accessible facility with multiple services and a community atmosphere.
